headline: Tutorial: MiniMax Releases Free AI Music Generator "Music3" That Can Generate Songs Up to 5 Minutes Long Locally, Even Cantonese Songs!
summary: Chinese AI developer MiniMax launched its MiniMax-Music3 music generation model on August 14, 2026, with free open weights. The model can run locally and generate songs with vocals from text instructions.
why: MiniMax is a Chinese AI developer competing in generative AI models, and open-weights releases shape competition in the AI model market.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: 教學：MiniMax 免費音樂生成 AI「Music3」 可在本機生成最長 5 分鐘歌曲 廣東話歌都得！
